sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Tagged construct used as a surface receptor in in vitro AAV library selection, implying successful surface display; carbonic anhydrase enzymatic activity not measured.
sites.rationale: CA4 is a GPI-anchored protein with its entire mature domain (residues 19–312) extracellular and no transmembrane segment. Replacing the C-terminal GPI anchor with an HA tag is the canonical approach for tagging GPI-anchored proteins on the extracellular face; the junction falls at the C-terminus of the extracellular span (after residue 312, R). The evidence is indirect (mouse CA-IV ortholog) and no residue is named, so position_evidence is topology_derived. Confidence is low because the ortholog gap and the uncertainty about whether the resulting construct remains membrane-anchored (GPI signal replaced by HA alone may yield a secreted protein, though AAV selection use implies surface display). Mouse CA-IV (ortholog of human CA4) was engineered with its C-terminal GPI anchor replaced by an HA tag, producing a full-length tagged construct used for in vitro AAV library selection. No specific residue junction is named; the C-terminal position is derived from the topology (extracellular span 19–312, GPI-anchored protein with no TM domain).

sources.claim: Mouse receptors LY6A and CA-IV were modified by replacing their C-terminal glycosylphosphatidylinositol (GPI) anchors with a hemagglutinin (HA) tag.

literature_notes: Only one ledger line (L1) was provided. It reports mouse CA-IV (ortholog) with GPI anchor replaced by HA tag for AAV library selection; no residue is named. The site is included as topology_derived terminal_c because: (1) the construct is described as full-length, (2) AAV library selection requires surface receptor display, and (3) the C-terminus is the only feasible extracellular tag position for a GPI-anchored protein. Confidence is low due to the ortholog gap and ambiguity about whether the HA-only replacement maintains membrane anchoring. No N-terminal tag evidence exists in the ledger. No internal loop insertion evidence exists in the ledger.
